title: Spend an evening at the Library of Congress
description: On selected Thursday evenings, the Library of Congress opens the Thomas Jefferson Building for its Live! at the Library program. Wander through exhibitions and the grand halls, then choose a conversation, performance, or display from the current calendar. When access is offered, a quiet look into the Main Reading Room can be the evening’s most memorable pause.
teaser: See the Library of Congress after ordinary visiting hours.
goodToKnow: Choose a current Library of Congress evening program and confirm seating and access before visiting.
whyItMightDelightYou: The building feels especially inviting when its collections become part of a live evening program.
